headline: Wardens Retake Expanse Ground as Gutter Erupts; Nevish Line Eases
war_summary: Wardens have clawed back ground in the Weathered Expanse, where the war's heaviest fighting has left five works Warden, two Colonial and two unclaimed — a reversal of the four-to-three Colonial edge reported at the last edition, with Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch all in play. The Gutter, quiet at the previous dispatch, has become the fiercest field of the moment: seventy-three actions in the day and eleven in the last two hours around Kuoppa and The Parras, its works now five Warden, one Colonial and one unclaimed. The Nevish Line has eased from its peak yet still shows twenty-one actions in the day, Wardens holding eight of its works. Marban Hollow, three works apiece with two unclaimed, has gone silent in the last two hours after twenty actions in the day at Oster Wall. Callahans Passage again reports the heaviest toll, 10,594 Colonial and 7,575 Warden casualties in the day, without a work changing hands. Colonials hold 301 works to 126 Warden, nine unclaimed.
